values.note: Single site $26 per night (recreation.gov 2026-2028, peak and first-come weeks alike). One RV with tow vehicle per site; an extra vehicle is $7 a night on the FS page ($8 as a recreation.gov add-on or collected at the campground).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/lake-michigan-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $7 per vehicle per night'; page last updated September 14, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234081/rates (PeakSTANDARD NONELECTRIC 26 and Walk InSTANDARD NONELECTRIC 26, 2026-2028) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234081 ('Extra vehicle will be charged an $8 per night fee'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Half-price camping with the Golden Age Passport or America the Beautiful Senior/Access pass (not at day-use sites). Military Annual and Gold Star passes cover day-use fees only, not camping.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/lake-michigan-campground ('Discount passes are honored with ½ price camping only include: Golden Age Passport and America the Beautiful (Interagency) Senior Pass issued to senior citizens and physically disabled citizens.' 'Military Annual and Gold Star Veteran Passes are good for covering day use fees ONLY, they do not cover camping fees.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov or (877) 444-6777 up to 4 days before arrival; 19 of the 33 sites are reservable, 14 first-come, and the rate table runs a first-come-only week at opening (2026: May 15-21). Weekends 2 nights, holiday weekends 3. Reserved sites stay reserved even when empty and cannot be traded for walk-up sites; a reservation is forfeited if you have not arrived by check-out time the next day. No office: self-pay station. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/lake-michigan-campground ('Campground has first come, first served sites and reservable sites.' 'Reservations can be made using www.recreation.gov or by calling (877) 444-6777' 'Reservations are forfeited if you have not arrived by check-out time the day after your scheduled arrival.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234081 (facility_rules: reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival', minWeekendStay 2 'Ignore Holidays', minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14 'consecutive days'; notices 'reservation sites are for reservations only', 'Reservation sites cannot be traded for walk up sites.', 'It has a self pay station') + /rates ('First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-15 2026-05-21') + RIDB catalog (19 STANDARD NONELECTRIC reservable, 14 not), read 2026-10-25

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/lake-michigan-campground ('Seasons of Use May 15 - September 13'; page last updated September 14, 2026), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/lake-michigan-campground ('Campground is rustic. There are no hookups for electricity, water or sewer.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 33 shaded and open sites for tents and RVs on grass-and-dirt parking spurs, all back-in; listed maximum vehicle lengths 30-45 ft (26 sites 45 ft). Maximum 8 people per site.

sites.source: RIDB catalog for facility 234081 (33 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites, 'Driveway Entry: Back-In' on all, Max Vehicle Length 45 (26), 40, 38, 30 (5); fetched 2026-10-20) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234081 ('many shaded and open sites for tent and RV camping'; 'Parking spurs are comprised of grass and dirt') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/lake-michigan-campground ('Maximum 8 people per site'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Accessible vault toilets, drinking water, trash bin. The nearest dump station is at Brevoort Lake Campground, about five miles away.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/lake-michigan-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234081 ('Accessible vault toilets are available, as well as drinking water.' 'a dump station can be found at Brevort Lake'), read 2026-10-25

note: Campsites are in the woods, very close to Lake Michigan.  --AWH  Hiawatha NF campground along a bluff between US-2 and Lake Michigan, 16 mi west of the I-75/US-2 junction (about 18 mi from St. Ignace); sites sit among 20-30 ft dunes, steps from a long sand beach. The Sand Dunes Cross-Country Ski Trail and the North Country Trail are reachable from camp. Concession-run. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Sep 14, 2026) + recreation.gov + RIDB: $26/night (confirmed), Senior/Access half price (new), reservable on recreation.gov to 4 days out with 14 of 33 sites first-come (fcfs/cutoff new), weekend 2-night and holiday 3-night minimums and 14-night max (new), season May 15 - Sep 13 (new), no electric/water/sewer hookups (electric confirmed, water/sewer new), 33 back-in sites to 45 ft (new), vault toilets + potable water (new). Concession-run (concessionaire (906) 767-1111). Access is straight off US-2; no Hiawatha alert or order names this campground. AWH note kept verbatim; Claude setting text added after it.
